text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Ocean Fortress - (built 1984) 29,125 dwt sold to Turkish buyers for $8.8 million.
Lazaros L - (built 1977) 28,637 dwt sold to the mortgagees for $3.53 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Bela Kun - (built 1968) 12,640 dwt sold to Indan breakers for $162 per ldt.
Zim Elat - (built 1973) 31,846 dwt sold for $186 delivery India.
Guo Cai - (built 1975) 10,043 dwt sold for $176.50 delivery India.
River Andoni - (built 1979) 12,000 dwt sold in fire damaged condition for $73 delivery "as is".
Oak - (built 1971) 57,897 dwt sold for $172 delivery Vietnam.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
